name: sdn-element-sync
description: SDN element-set sync (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON). Pure C++ merge step of the SDN-AP data path; the host connectors move the bytes (p2p-discovery pulls a peer's latest $OMM dataset and its signed $PNV notice, flatsql-query reads the cache, storage-ingest writes it, the harness schedules), this module decides. Method "merge": ONE $QRP window Request (FROM_EPOCH_MS the cache window start = now minus the cache days, 7 days by default; AS_OF_MS now; TO_EPOCH_MS an optional upper bound; LIMIT an optional cap that drops the oldest first) with the $OMM sets read back from the cache ("cached") and the sets just pulled from a peer ("pulled", accepted only beside a $PNV notice whose entries are all signature-verified). It drops sets whose EPOCH is before the window (expiry by epoch), de-duplicates on object, theory, originator and EPOCH (a pulled set wins over a cached one), and answers the window snapshot sorted by NORAD_CAT_ID, OBJECT_ID, theory, EPOCH on "omm" (the epoch store's load port: size-prefixed $OMM streams of at most 4 MiB per frame), the sets not yet cached on "store" (for storage-ingest), the cutoff on "expire" (a $QRP Request: SCHEMA_NAME OMM, TO_EPOCH_MS the window start), the accepted $PNV notices byte for byte on "notice" (the signed provenance the host re-seeds with the sets; this module never signs and never alters a notice) and the counts on "summary" (a $QRP Page). No hostcalls, no capabilities.

sequentialJustification.detail: One merge of the frames of one invocation on the calling thread; nothing survives the invocation and no thread is created.

methods.displayName: Merge Element Sets Into The Cache Window

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP Request: FROM_EPOCH_MS the window start (0 = unbounded), AS_OF_MS now, TO_EPOCH_MS optional upper bound (0 = none), LIMIT optional cap (0 = none).

inputPorts.description: $QRP Request: FROM_EPOCH_MS the window start (0 = unbounded), AS_OF_MS now, TO_EPOCH_MS optional upper bound (0 = none), LIMIT optional cap (0 = none).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $OMM sets read back from the cache (single records or size-prefixed streams, any number of frames).

inputPorts.description: $OMM sets read back from the cache (single records or size-prefixed streams, any number of frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $OMM sets pulled from a peer (single records or size-prefixed streams); refused unless a signature-verified $PNV notice rides with them.

inputPorts.description: $OMM sets pulled from a peer (single records or size-prefixed streams); refused unless a signature-verified $PNV notice rides with them.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $PNV notice(s) of the pulled batch: every entry SIGNATURE_VERIFIED; passed on byte for byte.

inputPorts.description: $PNV notice(s) of the pulled batch: every entry SIGNATURE_VERIFIED; passed on byte for byte.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The window snapshot, sorted by NORAD_CAT_ID, OBJECT_ID, theory, ORIGINATOR, EPOCH: size-prefixed $OMM streams, at most 4 MiB per frame (the epoch store's load port).

outputPorts.description: The window snapshot, sorted by NORAD_CAT_ID, OBJECT_ID, theory, ORIGINATOR, EPOCH: size-prefixed $OMM streams, at most 4 MiB per frame (the epoch store's load port).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Pulled sets in the window that the cache does not hold yet (a new key, or the same key with different bytes): size-prefixed $OMM streams for storage-ingest.

outputPorts.description: Pulled sets in the window that the cache does not hold yet (a new key, or the same key with different bytes): size-prefixed $OMM streams for storage-ingest.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP Request: SCHEMA_NAME OMM, TO_EPOCH_MS the window start; the cache drops its sets with an EPOCH before it.

outputPorts.description: $QRP Request: SCHEMA_NAME OMM, TO_EPOCH_MS the window start; the cache drops its sets with an EPOCH before it.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The accepted $PNV notices byte for byte (signed provenance; never re-signed).

outputPorts.description: The accepted $PNV notices byte for byte (signed provenance; never re-signed).
